title: MORE
tagline: The Lord has more for you today.
focus_line: Grace is the undeserved kindness and power of God working in us and for us.

verse.text: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: ‘God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.’

session.prompt: Step away alone and let today's verse reveal evidence of God's work in your life.

coaching_notes: In the gym, I'm always quick to be graceful with humble athletes. If someone thinks they have it all figured out and there's nothing left to learn, I will leave them to themselves. Think about how that applies in your spiritual life.
